### Added

- *(workspaces)* The workspace-manager component behind one switch in [#902](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/902) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(kagent)* Follow kagent 1.6 and Substrate 1.7 in [#905](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/905) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* The workspace StorageClass name as a chart value in [#906](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/906) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Route the workspace-manager's browser sign-in in [#907](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/907) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Forward the StorageClass to workspace-manager rc.13 in [#909](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/909) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(presets)* Serve mistral-small-4 text only on llm-d-cuda v0.8.0 in [#908](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/908) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Floor workspace-manager at its first stable, 0.1.1 in [#910](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/910) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
